source_policy: Only public titles, URLs, byte counts, hashes, manuscript status and inspection history are reproduced. Source bytes and extracted source text are excluded.

sources.title: Discrete Differential Geometry
sources.inspected_locations: Problem 7, printed p.108 (PDF page 34); context and references through p.109
sources.inspection: Full target and background read; p.108 rendered and visually inspected. No simple/simplicial assumption.

sources.title: Open Problems in Discrete Differential Geometry
sources.inspection: Read target and source references; agrees with published OWR statement.

sources.title: The Colin de Verdiere number and graphs of polytopes
sources.manuscript_status: arXiv v3, 25 July 2008; later Israel Journal of Mathematics publication
sources.inspection: Read theorem/proof and mixed-volume signature derivation. General convex polytopes; simple polytopes mentioned in background do not restrict theorem.

sources.title: On the null space of a Colin de Verdiere matrix
sources.inspection: Read nullspace construction and conjectural 4-connected linkless-graph extension. Does not prove four-dimensional claim.

sources.title: The Strong Arnold Property for 4-connected flat graphs
sources.manuscript_status: 2015 v1 preprint; 2017 Linear Algebra and its Applications publication
sources.inspection: Read Strong Arnold theorem and proof mechanism; its intro explicitly leaves normalized-nullspace flatness as a question.

sources.title: Some aspects of the combinatorial theory of convex polytopes
sources.inspection: Read lower bound and equality statements and surrounding argument. Internal p.12 visually inspected for d>3 and d>=4 conditions. Original 1987 proof not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Some aspects of the combinatorial theory of convex polytopes (scanned chapter)
sources.inspection: OCR and visual identification establish this is the 1994 chapter, not the 1987 paper. Superseded for detailed reading by author-hosted text.

sources.title: Bipartite graphs with no K6 minor
sources.manuscript_status: 2022 v1 preprint; 2024 Journal of Combinatorial Theory B publication
sources.inspection: Mader bound is explicitly a general graph theorem, not limited to bipartite graphs. It is used as cited established input; Mader original proof not independently reproduced.

sources.title: Linkless embeddings of graphs in 3-space
sources.inspection: Read distinction between fixed embedding and graph-level embeddability. This source sometimes defines linkless by mod-two number, so equivalence with flat embeddability is used only at graph level.

sources.title: A survey of linkless embeddings
sources.inspection: Scanned PDF OCR inspected; K6 parity proof and flat-embedding definitions checked. Full deep excluded-minor proof is not reproduced.

sources.title: Links and knots in the graphs of four-dimensional polytopes
sources.inspection: Read known pyramid/stacked observations and prospective truncated-simplex illustration. This is background and novelty caution, not reliance on an unverified diagram.

sources.title: Linear linkless embeddings: proof of a conjecture by Sachs
sources.manuscript_status: Published 20 November 2025; proof criticized in 2026 preprint
sources.inspected_locations: Introduction and printed p.4594 passage flagged by Naimi
sources.inspection: Read stated scope and flagged passage. Not used as a theorem, and its linearization conclusion would not by itself fix the natural polytope embedding.

sources.title: A Gap in Stanfield's Proof of Sachs' Linear Linkless Embedding Conjecture
sources.manuscript_status: arXiv v1, submitted 10 March 2026; manuscript dated 12 March 2026
sources.inspection: Full text read. Reports a gap in a local disk-disjointness argument, not a counterexample to the general linearization theorem; no claim to adjudicate publication status beyond these sources.
